page: Microsoft Azure D96ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DADSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with x86_64 architecture, featuring 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 48 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. The processor operates at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz and includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It supports hardware-assisted virtualization via SVM, alongside cryptographic instructions like AES, VAES, and SHA_ni, though it lacks AVX-512 and AMX extensions.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage capabilities include 3686 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server type.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU testing placing in the top 10% and PassMark CPU encryption tests also reaching the top tier. Memory performance is highly polarized: PassMark memory score and small-block cached read bandwidth are in the top 10% and top 25% respectively, whereas large-block uncached read and write bandwidths fall into the middle 50%. Single-core performance is generally strong to average, with Geekbench single-core scores in the middle 50% and stress-ng single-core in the top 25%.

Given its high core count, balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, and substantial local storage, the D96ads_v5 offers high resource density for multi-threaded workloads. It is well-suited for database operations, software compilation, image processing, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, as evidenced by strong PassMark database and Geekbench compilation benchmarks. The qualitative cost efficiency is favorable for enterprises requiring high parallel processing capabilities and local scratch space without the overhead of dedicated GPU hardware.
